address: 54 Lamb's Conduit Street, Bloomsbury, London, WC1N 3LW, United Kingdom
bio: Same concept; new, brighter, larger location: Honey & Co has been reborn and fans of the original will be delighted. Vibrant, colourful dishes offer the classic flavours and textures of Middle Eastern cooking and are designed for sharing. If you can’t decide on what to have, go for the tasting option, which offers a small portion of every dish on the menu....
